name: software.brainiac/web-intelligence
title: BRAINIAC Web & Page Intelligence
description: Paid Web & Page Intelligence API via x402. Unpaid tool calls return 402.

tools.name: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown
tools.description: Fetch one public webpage and convert its readable HTML into Markdown, returning title, byline, excerpt, finalUrl, contentType, fetchedAt, and wordCount when present. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/web-intelligence/url-to-markdown Keywords: url to markdown, read webpage, fetch url, article extract, title, excerpt, finalUrl, fetchedAt, markdown.

tools.name: web-intelligence_structured-page-extract
tools.description: Extract caller-defined fields from one public webpage. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/web-intelligence/structured-page-extract Keywords: when you need structured facts from a web page, url, schema, requestedUrl, finalUrl, httpStatus, contentType, warnings, fields, Extract structured page data, structured page extract.

type.description: type, string, one of string, number, boolean, url. Required.

tools.name: web-intelligence_page-change-detect
tools.description: Fetch a public page and compare its Markdown with a caller-supplied previous snapshot. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/web-intelligence/page-change-detect Keywords: when you need structured facts from a web page, url, previousMarkdown, previousRetrievedAt, requestedUrl, finalUrl, httpStatus, contentType, warnings, changed, Detect page changes, page change detect.

tools.name: web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract
tools.description: Read title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, language, and robots directives from one public page. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/web-intelligence/website-metadata-extract Keywords: when you need structured facts from a web page, url, requestedUrl, finalUrl, httpStatus, contentType, warnings, title, description, Extract website metadata, website metadata extract.

tools.name: web-intelligence_website-contact-extract
tools.description: Read publicly displayed emails, tel: links, address elements, and structured contact data from one public page. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/web-intelligence/website-contact-extract Keywords: when you need structured facts from a web page, url, requestedUrl, finalUrl, httpStatus, contentType, warnings, emails, phones, Extract website contacts, website contact extract.

tools.name: web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index
tools.description: Fetch one public sitemap or sitemap index and return the listed URLs with lastmod, changefreq, and priority when those fields are present. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/web-intelligence/sitemap-content-index Keywords: when you need structured facts from a web page, sitemapUrl, requestedUrl, finalUrl, httpStatus, contentType, warnings, kind, entryKind, Index sitemap content, sitemap content index.
